training: Only existing attributed lm-corpus-v1/train.jsonl; no new corpus or held-out references
algorithm: Interpolated modified Kneser-Ney style character trigram: raw highest-order counts; distinct-predecessor bigram counts except raw BOS contexts; distinct-predecessor unigram counts with existing additive 0.1 floor. Per-order discounts estimated from full adjusted count-of-counts before pruning. Sparse/invalid estimates use 0.75. Pruned direct mass backs off exactly.
scope: A character-model smoothing experiment, not the KenLM scalable estimator, not a copied binary, and not yet a production change

development.gate: Each domain top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and top1 character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly higher. Keep every regression. Known development data, not new blind evaluation.

test: Do not open additional held-out candidate results unless development passes. Any previously viewed test is labeled known regression, not new evidence.
deployment: No factory/asset change during this experiment. Offline development success alone does not authorize promotion: independent quality, progressive short-input, personalization and Android lifecycle/cost remain required.
